title: [CQ-R11d] Check environment identity and evidence freshness
definitionOfDone: checkEnvironment returns the same identity for the same inputs and a different one when any input or CHECK_BOUNDARIES field changes. Invalid or extra-key input refuses with CHECK_INPUT_INVALID and fixed text. All shown by tests.
CHECK_BOUNDARIES is deeply frozen and names the identity, network, process, filesystem, resource and time boundaries with fixed rlimit values; a test pins its exact content.
evidenceStatus returns 'fresh' only for an exact match of environment, treeSha, definitionDigest and planRevision, and 'stale' for any change or missing field. Shown by tests.
The CI local-runner step in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs, and the verification command exits 0 with its output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Create scripts/local-runner/check-evidence.mjs with CHECK_BOUNDARIES and checkEnvironment, plus rows E1-E5 in the new scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs. Write the rows first (test-driven-development).

The module is pure: no provider call, no file read, no clock.
- Header comment in the local-runner style: CHECK_BOUNDARIES is the contract that CQ-R11a/R11b implement, a descriptor and not a measurement. Nothing here claims isolation: executionReady stays false and verified-local stays unavailable.
- Import only createHash from node:crypto, plus GUEST_LAYOUT, GUEST_RESOURCES and JOB_IDENTITIES from ./guest-bootstrap.mjs. Derive values from those constants; never retype them.
- Add a private deep-freeze helper that mirrors doctor.mjs's private freeze(). Do not export doctor's.
- CHECK_BOUNDARIES = deepFreeze({
  identity: { user: JOB_IDENTITIES[1], supplementaryGroups: [], noNewPrivileges: true, umask: '077' },
  network: { namespace: 'private', interfaces: ['lo'] },
  resources: { vm: { ...GUEST_RESOURCES }, rlimits: { RLIMIT_CORE: 0, RLIMIT_FSIZE: 1073741824, RLIMIT_NOFILE: 4096, RLIMIT_NPROC: 2048 } },
  process: { group: 'session', teardown: 'killed-and-reaped', vm: 'deleted-after-run' },
  filesystem: { vm: 'fresh-owned-per-run', home: { fresh: true, mode: '0700' }, protectedPaths: { owner: 'root', verified: ['before-run', 'after-run'] }, supervisorCredential: { path: GUEST_LAYOUT.credential, owner: 'root', mode: '0400', jobIdentities: 'readiness-denied' } },
  time: { budget: 'host-enforced' },
}).
  One comment on rlimits: each value is both the soft and the hard limit, and CQ-R11a applies exactly these through Python's resource module; its drift test pins them. There is no RLIMIT_AS, because V8 reserves large virtual ranges and the VM's memory size already bounds RAM. There is no RLIMIT_CPU, because the host enforces the wall-clock budget.
- checkEnvironment(inputs):
  - inputs must be a record (non-null object, not an array). Its Object.keys set must be exactly providerImageHash, resources, sourceImageSha256 and supervisorSha256. Compare the length and the membership of Object.keys, never count + hasOwn (Serena memory gotcha-strict-decoder-key-set).
  - Read each value exactly once into a local, and validate and hash only those locals.
  - Each of the three hashes: typeof string AND /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/. The typeof check matters, because the regex coerces a String object.
  - resources: a record whose key set is exactly Object.keys(GUEST_RESOURCES) (cpus, memoryBytes, diskBytes), each value a safe integer >= 1. This is shape only: the values need not equal GUEST_RESOURCES, since the R11 orchestrator may pass the observed size.
  - Any failure throws Object.assign(new Error('Check environment input was invalid.'), { code: 'CHECK_INPUT_INVALID' }). The text is fixed and never carries a value, key or type.
  - Return 'moe-local-vm-v1:' + the sha256 hex of canonicalJson({ boundaries: CHECK_BOUNDARIES, inputs: { providerImageHash, resources: { cpus, diskBytes, memoryBytes }, sourceImageSha256, supervisorSha256 } }).
  - canonicalJson is private. Arrays keep their order. Record keys are sorted by code unit at every depth. Strings, numbers and booleans go through JSON.stringify, with no whitespace. The 80-character result fits CheckRun.environment's rule (255 characters at most, no control characters; readEnvironment in packages/moe-daemon/src/state/checkRunStore.ts).

Rows use node:test and node:assert/strict, named 'E1 ...'. VALID is a deep-frozen fixture of three distinct 64-hex values plus the GUEST_RESOURCES numbers; frozen, so an implementation that mutates its input throws.
- E1 (DoD 2): CHECK_BOUNDARIES deepStrictEqual a LITERAL copy in the test. Retype 'moe-check', 2, 4294967296, 21474836480, '/etc/moe/supervisor.credential' and the rlimits there; do not import them back. Every object and array reachable from it is Object.isFrozen, and a strict-mode write and an array push both throw TypeError.
- E2: checkEnvironment(VALID) equals 'moe-local-vm-v1:' + the sha256 of the TEST's own independent sorted-key canonical encoder over { boundaries: CHECK_BOUNDARIES, inputs: VALID }. Follow the framedDigest pattern in local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs. The result matches /^moe-local-vm-v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$/. A fresh copy with every key order reversed (top level and resources) gives the same value, and repeated calls agree.
- E3: any input change gives a different identity: one hex character in each hash field, +1 in each resources field, and two hashes swapped.
- E4: any CHECK_BOUNDARIES change gives a different identity. Walk a structuredClone and mutate every leaf (string, number, boolean, array element), every array (append) and every object (delete each key, add one key). For each mutant clone, the oracle digest differs from checkEnvironment(VALID). Together with E2's equality, this proves every boundary field is in the preimage.
- E5 refusals, each asserting instanceof Error, code CHECK_INPUT_INVALID and the exact message:
  - no argument, null, 'x', 42, [], and Object.assign([], VALID), which pins the array exclusion;
  - each key missing, and an extra key;
  - a required key redefined as non-enumerable, plus an enumerable extra added by assignment AFTER defineProperty (a spread would drop it);
  - per hash field: uppercase, 63 and 65 characters, a non-hex character, a trailing '\n', undefined, null, 42, and new String(valid hex);
  - resources null or [], a missing key and an extra key;
  - per resources field: 0, -1, 1.5, NaN, Infinity, '2', 2n, null, and Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1.

Error handling: the refusal is the only failure path. The function never logs or echoes its input.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review of this task's diff. Load the adversarial-self-review skill first.

Check each of these:
- A hostile input (accessors, non-enumerable keys, a Proxy, an array, a String object, a BigInt) cannot get past checkEnvironment or make the hashed value differ from the validated one.
- No message carries input.
- evidenceStatus cannot return 'fresh' when a field is missing on both sides, inherited, blank or malformed.
- No nested object of CHECK_BOUNDARIES can be mutated.
- The identity depends on every boundary leaf and every input.

Mutation-probe each guard in a scratch copy, never the shared tree (recipe in the Serena memory gotcha-local-runner-tests). Record which row kills each mutant, and judge equivalence before calling a survivor a gap. Fix any gap with a row, then re-run step 4's command fresh before complete_task.

Confirm that nothing anywhere claims verified-local, isolation or executionReady.
implementationPlan.note: Adversarial review found one real gap: a throwing accessor or Proxy trap escaped checkEnvironment as the caller's own error instead of the fixed CHECK_INPUT_INVALID. Fixed with a failing row first, plus a validatedInputs()/try-catch split. 43 mutants probed in /tmp/r11d-mut (scratch copy only): 40 killed, 3 equivalent survivors. (1) record() null check: Object.keys(null) throws, and the catch turns that into the same refusal. (2) freshnessFields null guard: Object.hasOwn(null) throws inside the try and returns stale. (3) === to ==: both sides are already type-checked in the same slot. Diff is 397 lines, under the 400 limit. No forbidden patterns; the only isolation/verified-local/executionReady mentions are the header's negations.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
Rejected these options:
- A boundaries parameter on checkEnvironment, or exporting canonicalJson for the tests. Either widens the public surface; E2's independent oracle plus E4's mutated clones prove boundary sensitivity without an export.
- A golden identity literal. It is redundant with E1 + E2.
- Format validation of treeSha and definitionDigest in evidenceStatus. CheckRun fields are opaque and compared exactly.
- RLIMIT_AS, which breaks V8, and RLIMIT_CPU, since the host owns time.
- A prototype guard on inputs. Own reads into fresh literals make it unnecessary.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- GUEST_RESOURCES {cpus 2, memoryBytes 4 GiB, diskBytes 20 GiB}, JOB_IDENTITIES ['moe-agent','moe-check'] and GUEST_LAYOUT.credential '/etc/moe/supervisor.credential' (root:root '0400' via cloud-init) are all in guest-bootstrap.mjs.
- waitForGuestReady (guest-readiness.mjs) returns image.source.sha256, image.provider.imageHash (lowercased 64-hex; lifecycle.mjs isSha256) and supervisorSha256. Those are the R11-final inputs.
- CheckRun.environment is non-blank, at most 255 characters and free of control characters.
- CheckRun has no definitionDigest field (CQ-V03's concern), so legacy rows are always stale.
- Both bundlers copy scripts/local-runner wholesale, so the new module needs no bundler change. scripts/tests is not bundled.
- CQ-R11e will later add a toolchain digest input to checkEnvironment.
planningNotes.risks:
- Object.hasOwn(null) throws.
- The regex coerces String objects.
- In tests, a spread drops non-enumerable keys.
- The global forbiddenPatterns (__proto__, eval(, innerHTML) apply to test strings too: use 'constructor' or 'valueOf' instead.
- Keep the diff at or under 400 changed lines.
- Append the CI entry at the end of the run line; the bundle test regex pins its prefix.
- The target paths were clean at planning time, but 611 peer dirty paths exist in the checkout. Never touch them.

completionSummary: Added scripts/local-runner/check-evidence.mjs (pure, no provider call). CHECK_BOUNDARIES is deep-frozen and pins identity moe-check, a loopback-only private network namespace, VM size from GUEST_RESOURCES, rlimits CORE 0 / FSIZE 1073741824 / NOFILE 4096 / NPROC 2048, session-group teardown, a fresh VM per run, a fresh 0700 home, protected paths verified before and after the run, a 0400 supervisor credential that job identities are denied, and a host-enforced budget. checkEnvironment({sourceImageSha256, providerImageHash, supervisorSha256, resources}) returns 'moe-local-vm-v1:' + the sha256 of a sorted-key canonical JSON of boundaries and inputs (80 characters). It uses an exact enumerable key set, a typeof string check plus a lowercase 64-hex regex, a safe integer >= 1 for each resource, and one read per value. Any invalid input, extra key, or throwing accessor/Proxy trap refuses with CHECK_INPUT_INVALID and the fixed text. evidenceStatus(observation, current) returns 'fresh' only when environment, treeSha, definitionDigest and planRevision are all own, valid and strictly equal on both sides; otherwise 'stale', and it never throws. New scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs has 11 tests (E1-E8) and is appended at the end of the CI local-runner run line in .github/workflows/ci.yml, which the bundle test's prefix check still accepts. Mutation probes: 43 mutants in a scratch copy, 40 killed and 3 equivalent survivors judged. Diff is 397 changed lines. executionReady stays false and verified-local stays unavailable; nothing claims isolation.
reviewSummary:
Approved. Reviewed recorded completion commit fdaf5ff (on moe/work-2026-10-24, pushed); the owned paths match the working tree.

Re-ran verification fresh: env -i + nvm Node 24, `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner-check.test.mjs` -> exit 0, 11/11 (E1-E8). Bundle test 'cross-platform CI' passes, so the CI run-line prefix pin holds. Size 397 changed lines (112 + 283 + ci.yml 1/1), under 400.

DoD 1: checkEnvironment is deterministic and changes with any input or boundary change (E2 independent oracle, E3 per-input, E4 60+ boundary mutants all distinct). E5 pins CHECK_INPUT_INVALID with fixed text for bad types, array/String/BigInt, missing/extra/non-enumerable keys, throwing accessors and Proxy traps; one read per value.

DoD 2: CHECK_BOUNDARIES deep-frozen; E1 deepStrictEquals a retyped literal incl. rlimits and checks every node frozen.

DoD 3: evidenceStatus 'fresh' only for four own, valid, strictly equal fields; E6/E7 cover changed, missing, blank, inherited, malformed, hostile and throwing inputs.

DoD 4: ci.yml appends the file at the end of the local-runner line; E8 asserts it.

Rails: forbidden-pattern grep clean; module pure; no isolation or verified-local claim; no tests weakened.

Notes: CheckRun lacks definitionDigest until CQ-V03; R11a drift test must pin the rlimits. I did not re-run the worker's mutation probe.
